title: Зажимы натяжные прессуемые типа НАС-Б

text_blocks.text: ЛИНЕЙНАЯ АРМАТУРА ДЛЯ ВЛ / АРМАТУРА НАТЯЖНАЯ
ФОРЭНЕРГО производственное объединение — FORENERGO industrial group
НАЗНАЧЕНИЕ: Предназначены для монтажа сталеалюминиевых проводов сечением 35 мм² и выше по ГОСТ 839-80. Опрессовываются шестигранными матрицами. Изготавливаются по ТУ 3449-001-52819896-2010.

figures.title: Чертёж зажима натяжного НАС-Б
figures.description: Main side view of the tension clamp with eye end at left and crimped barrel at right: L and L1 span horizontally (L1 within/offset from L) from the eye area along the barrel; L2 spans the barrel section; H is the overall vertical height on the right; Ød1 denotes the eye hole diameter; two arrows labelled 'направление опрессования' indicate crimping direction on the barrel. An angled branch (conductor leg) view shows L3 along the angled leg with width dimensions b and B, with a small end-profile detail showing b as the leg width. Section В–В is a circular cross-section with diameters D and d. Exact endpoints of L, L1 and L3 are not fully resolvable at the provided resolution.

source_notes: Провода по ГОСТ 839-80, сечение 35 мм² и выше.
Footer: ООО «МЗВА-ЧЭМЗ», Тел./факс: +7 (495) 780-51-65, e-mail: zakaz@mzva.ru, www.mzva.ru, страница 102.
uncertainties: For НАС-300-1Б and НАС-600-2Б rows the L3 and H cells appear not filled for those specific groups; the values shown (e.g., 110/120/140 and 178/192/213) span multiple designation groups and their exact cell boundaries are ambiguous; merged spans are reproduced as read from the images.
Breaking-load values 65,33 and 84,43 (НАС-240-1Б) and 113,2 vs 101,8 (НАС-330-1Б) span different conductor rows; sub-row assignment is approximate.
Whether empty L3/H cells for НАС-300-1Б/НАС-600-2Б are truly blank or merged with adjacent groups is ambiguous at this resolution.
Dimension endpoint assignments in the drawing are partly ambiguous at the provided image resolution.
